question: Why can a flat caldera out-blast the tallest explosive volcano?
answer: A super caldera barely shows on the surface, so its power stays hidden. A huge magma chamber sits beneath it. When it erupts, the ground above collapses into the emptying chamber and everything blows out at once, releasing energy orders of magnitude beyond an ultra-plinian eruption.
move: Violence is set by the chamber below, not the mountain above.

web.label: Two eruption options: the tall explosive volcano or the flat caldera. The question asks which to erupt first and why the flat caldera can out-blast the taller mountain.

source: Geopop, “LA SPIEGAZIONE DI TUTTI I TIPI DI ERUZIONE - Parte-2” (YouTube, 2019)
